summary: The scene delivers Kalt's fatal drive and crash in concrete, physically grounded action that correctly retires him as the sole witness, but it saddles him with an invented workshop/second-residence biography that canon never gives him and that sits oddly against his established profession.

issues.unit: P3: "er wohnte allein in der Kammer über der Werkstatt, wenn er nicht daheim war"
issues.fix_hint: Cut the workshop-chamber clause; keep only that there was no one to tell and his wife was asleep.

issues.unit: P6: "er hatte es hundertmal jüngeren Leuten erklärt, in der Werkstatt, mit den Händen"
issues.fix_hint: Cut "in der Werkstatt" so the sentence doesn't lean on the ungrounded workshop detail from P3.
